result_rationale: The native, configurable, source-grounded, post-exit Graphiti pipeline and recovery behavior work end-to-end: recall-first persistence without semantic novelty vetoes; per-stage model/reasoning/temperature/budget/timeout/guidance controls bound to an immutable tuning-profile and model-request identity; fail-closed zero-inference --replay-only recovery that derives a new recall plan from 46 frozen discovery/utility responses with zero new model calls; per-stage token/latency/reasoning-token reporting; and positive terminal Graphiti write/readback across ReviewStore, episode-index, Graphiti MCP and raw FalkorDB. This does NOT assert the later >=85% prospective utility objective, zero duplicates, retrieval usefulness, or production readiness.
